invented.quote: The 9 new clinics made up for that revenue, which is why monthly revenue stayed flat instead of falling.
invented.why: The brief does not say how much the 9 new clinics paid or whether the flat revenue came from new clinics rather than expansion of existing customers.

invented.quote: For larger groups, a basic scheduler that comes free with their records system is a real competitor.
invented.why: The brief only states the scheduler is built into the electronic records system, not that it is basic or comes free.

invented.quote: It also works no matter which scheduler a clinic uses.
invented.why: The brief says the reminder feature will be sold on its own, not that it integrates with or works alongside any other scheduler.

invented.quote: This lets us sell to clinics that are committed to their records system's scheduler, including groups like the chain we just lost, without having to replace that scheduler.
invented.why: The brief does not state why the reminder feature is being sold on its own or that it can be used alongside a records system's scheduler.
